noun_definition: Accounting refers to the feature within the application that allows users to manage financial data and connect to external accounting services like Xero.
Workspace settings page is the interface within the application where users can configure settings related to their workspace after navigating from the accounting page.
User refers to an individual interacting with the application who expects to be navigated to the workspaces list page after performing specific actions related to workspace settings.
Organizations page refers to the interface within the application where users can view and manage their connected organizations after navigating through the accounting and workspace settings pages.
